_metadata.description: Background generation conditioned on the profile, competing on equal footing with owned music.

requirements.title: Generation is conditioned on the current profile
requirements.description: A background queue produces candidates from the active preference profile, sampling across its uncertain regions rather than only its peak, so generation explores as well as exploits.

validation.notes: Generation requests span uncertain regions, not only the profile maximum

requirements.title: Generated tracks re-enter the same index
requirements.description: Generated audio is decomposed by the same pipeline as owned audio and ranked by the same model, with no scoring advantage or penalty for being generated. Disclosure is a presentation and provenance concern, never a ranking one.

validation.notes: Provenance does not alter the computed score

requirements.title: Generation is bounded and gets discarded
requirements.description: The queue respects a storage budget and a GPU-contention policy, and candidates that fail to earn listening are evicted. Producing many and keeping few is the intended behaviour, not a failure mode.

validation.notes: Budget honoured; unlistened candidates evicted; generation yields under contention

requirements.title: Directed requests alongside the queue
requirements.description: The listener can ask for a specific piece of music in their own words and have it produced without disturbing the background queue or the profile, unless they choose to feed the result back.

validation.notes: Directed requests bypass profile conditioning and do not implicitly update it
